translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Corintogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Corintios

content: Ani Pablo, Bab-Dummad-sogedba anse gollesad, Jesucristo-nuggi-barmilealidga guegar. Gwenad-Sóstenes anbo bemarse garda narmaksiid.

Bemar Bab Dummadgadid, bemar Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-Corintogi-danar-ambikunoni-damalad, bemar Cristo-Jesúsgi gwage-swilidik gunonimalad. Bab Dummad bemarse gochad, belagwapa dulemar bela neg-sukungan-gwen-bessuli Dummad-Jesucristose gorbukmaladba mesa egi akananai-gumalagar. A-Jesucristode amar-Dummadga gunonikid, degine, anmar-Dummadmogad.
Bab Dummad, anmar-Baba, degi, Dummad-Jesucristo, amar bitigi bemargi nued binsamalana-gadin, degine, ulubgi bogidik bemar-itogega imakbalina-yerban.
Pablo gwenadganga dog-nuedye Bab Dummadga sogsad
Bemarga gusgu dog-nuedye an Bab Dummadga an sog-daed, ar Cristo-Jesús-nuggi Bab Dummad bemarga binsaed-nuegan uksadba.
Ar Jesucristo-nuggi belagwapa ibmar-burbaled bemar nikunonikid, bela yeer-sunmaked, degi, bela ibmar-wisi-gued.
Degisoggu, Cristogi-gaya-burba-nued-sunmakleged bemargi oyolenonikid, we napiragwadye.
Deginbali, Bab Dummad bemarga belagwapa gurgin-burbarmalad-nuegan-ukedi, be galaku-deeye binsasurmalad, bela be nikmalad, unnila anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-danikoed-e-ibagan edarbedii be gumarsun.
Bab Dummaddi burgwedse be bendakdii-guoed, mer iskuedse be galakuegar, adi anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-e-ibagangi, bega igar-itolealile, be ibmar-gwen-oakalossuliyob daklegegar.
Ar Bab Dummad na e-ibmar-sogsadba na imaksoggu, bemarga ibmar-sogsad na imakodo. Bab Dummad na e bemarse gochad, adi E-Machiba, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristoba, anmar nue ailegegar.
Cristo danar-danar sordamar-nikusulid

Gwenadgan, an bemarse nue wilesakwaa anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo-nuggi gorsun, mer na be akar-akar sunmakmar, bela balibi na be imakmar, na bela be-damaladgi, degi, na be-binsamaladgi balibi bukwa be gumarsun.
Gwenadgan, weyob an bemarga soged, ar ade Cloé-neg-yaginmalad anga sogedba an bemar-itoged, bemarde na abin-abin imakdimarye.

An bemarga sogsun, ar bemarde abar sogdimalad: “Andi Pablo-sordaye,” baigandi sogmogad: “Andi Apolos-sordaye,” degi, baigandi sogdimogad: “Andi Pedro-sordaye,” deginbali, abar baigandi sogbalid: “Andi Cristo-sordaye.”
¿Ar ade Cristode danar-danar sordamar-seedsi? ¿Pablode bemarga nakrusgi burgwissi? ¿Ar ade bemarde Pablo-nuggi digi oglessi? Degisuli.
Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye an sogsundo, Bab-Jesús-digi an bemar-ogsasurmargu. Unnila Crispo, degi, Gayo, amarbi an Bab-Jesús-digi ogsad.
Degisoggu, geg bemar sogmalad: “An Pablo-nuggi digi oglesye.”
Deginbali, Estéfanas-neg-yagi-bukmalad an Bab-Jesús-digi ogsabalid, ar baigandi an insasulid an Bab-Jesús-digi ogsabar-dibe.

Ar ade Cristo an-barmissulid Bab-Jesús-digi dulemar-ogegar. Cristo an-barmisurbalid, dulemar ibmar-wisii sunmakedgi sunmakegar. Cristo an-barmisad, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued-egi-soglesadgi sunmakegar. Ar deyobsulile, Cristo-nakrusgi-burgwisad-e-igar gangued-gwen-niksur imaklego-itole.
Bab-ibmar-wisid, degine, e-gangued Cristoba oyolenonikid

Ar dulemar-yoggus-gudimaladgardi, Cristo-nakrusgi-burgwisadgi-sunmakleged-igar, we agumaked-igar gued, ar anmar-abonolesmaladgardi we Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi sunmaked, na Bab-Dummad-e-gangued anmarga oyoged.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naid:

Degite, ¿bia dule-binsaed-ibed nadsunna? ¿Bia escribamar nadsunna? ¿Bia dule-we-napneggi-igar-dummagan-mamaid-wisimalad nadsunna? ¿Ar we-napneggi-ibmar-wisimalad, Bab Dummad ibmar-wichulidyob imaksasursi? Eye, deyob imaksa.

Bab Dummad na bela e-ibmar-wisid dulemar-we-napnegginmalad na-e-binsaedgi e-amiega gwen imaksasulid. Ar bur e-gaya-burbagi-sunmakar dulemar-egi-bensurmalad abonogega imaksad, ar e-gaya-burba binsa-agumakedyob dakle-inigwer.
Ar Judiomardi ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad ega oyobi abemalad, Griegomardina ibmar-wisi-gued amidimalad.
Ar anmardi, Cristo-nakrusgi-burgwisad-igargi sunmakdiid. We-igar Judiomarga igar-nabiridsulid, Judiosurmaladdi, binsa igar-agumaked dakmalad.
Bab-Dummad-dulemarse-gochamaladgardi, Judiomarse, degi, Griegomarse, we Cristo, Bab-Dummad-e-ganguedid, degine, bela e-ibmar-wisidbalid.

Ar Bab-Dummad-igar dulemarga binsa-igar-agumakleged-daklegedi, we-binsaed dulemar-binsaedba bur binsaed-biriginedid, degine, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-saed bur nolloo-dakle-inigwele, degite, dulemar-ibmar-saedba bur gangued nikad.

Degisoggu gwenadgan, nue na be itomalana, dulemar-we-napnegginmalad bemar-dakmalad, Bab-Dummad-bemarse-gochamalad-abargi bemar ichee dulemar-binsaed-ibegan nikmalad, bemar ichee dulemar-dummagan nikmarbalid, degine, bemar ichee dulemar-nuga-nikamalad nikamarbalid.

Ar bur Bab Dummad we-napneggi dulemar-ibmar-wichurmaladse gochad, adi dulemar-ibmar-wismalad-obingesaegar, degine, we-napneggi dulemar-nollomaladse Bab Dummad gochad, adi dulemar-nollosurmalad-obingesaegar.
We-napneggi dulemar-baisur-dakledimalad, degi, dulemar-istar-dakledimalad Bab Dummad a-dulemar bur susad. Bab Dummad ibmar-sulid susad, adi ibmar-nikmalad osulogegar,
adi melle dule bipisaale Bab-Dummad-asabin na dukin san-odummomalagar.

Ar Bab-Dummad-sunnad Cristo-Jesúsgi bemar-oakanonikid, degi, bemar-imaknonikid, Cristo anmar-ibmar-nue-wisidga, iskussulidyob anmar-imaknonikid, anmar-gwage-swilidik-imaknonikid, degi, Cristogi anmar-baknonikid, anmar-abonogegar.
Adi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naidyob guegar:
